question: What inauspicious result follows when the rotation of the flag is deficient?
premises: Deficiency in rotation is a ritual fault
This fault brings inauspiciousness to the village and other places
inference: If the rotation of the flag is deficient, it brings inauspiciousness to the village and so forth.
plain_english: If the rotation of the flag is deficient, it brings inauspiciousness to the village and other places.
